sentences.zh: 尋卒。

translations.literal: He soon died.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon afterward.

sentences.zh: 太祖諸臣自葉赫來歸者，蘇納、固三泰、瑚什布皆與金台石同族。

translations.literal: Among Taizu's ministers who came over from Yehe, Suna, Gusantai, and Husibu were all of the same clan as Gintaisi.
translations.idiomatic: Among the ministers who came to Taizu from Yehe, Suna, Gusantai, and Husibu were all kinsmen of Gintaisi.

sentences.zh: 蘇納當葉赫未亡，棄兄弟歸太祖，太祖妻以女，為額駙。

translations.literal: While Yehe had not yet perished, Suna abandoned his brothers and came to Taizu; Taizu gave him his daughter in marriage and made him efuhu.
translations.idiomatic: Before Yehe fell, Suna left his brothers and submitted to Taizu, who gave him a daughter in marriage and made him an imperial son-in-law.

sentences.zh: 編所屬人戶為牛錄，使領牛錄額真，隸正白旗。

translations.literal: He registered the households under his command as a niru, appointed him niru ejen, and assigned him to the Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu organized his followers into a niru, made him niru captain, and enrolled him in the Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 天命四年，太祖滅葉赫，命蘇納收其戚屬隸所領牛錄。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Tianming Taizu destroyed Yehe and ordered Suna to gather its kinsmen and enroll them in the niru he led.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianming 4, after Taizu destroyed Yehe, he ordered Suna to gather Yehe kinsmen into the niru under his command.

sentences.zh: 十年，授甲喇額真。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was appointed jalan ejen.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was appointed jalan ejen.

sentences.zh: 錄戰功，賜敕免死四次。

translations.literal: His battle merit was recorded and an edict granted him four exemptions from death.
translations.idiomatic: His battlefield merit was recorded and he received an edict granting four exemptions from death.

sentences.zh: 尋擢梅勒額真。

translations.literal: He was soon promoted to meire ejen.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon promoted to meire ejen.

sentences.zh: 天聰元年，太宗自將伐明，攻錦州，以貝勒莽古爾泰等將偏師屯塔山，衛餉道；

translations.literal: In the first year of Tiancong Taizong personally led a campaign against Ming and attacked Jinzhou; he sent Beile Mangguertai and others with a detached force to garrison Tashan and guard the supply route;
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 1 Taizong led a Ming campaign in person and attacked Jinzhou. Beile Mangguertai and others were sent with a detached force to hold Tashan and guard the supply line;

sentences.zh: 命蘇納選八旗蒙古精銳別屯塔山西路，截明兵。

translations.literal: Suna was ordered to select elite Mongol troops from the Eight Banners to encamp separately on the western road of Tashan and intercept Ming troops.
translations.idiomatic: Suna was ordered to choose elite Mongol troops from the Eight Banners, post them separately on the western road at Tashan, and cut off Ming forces.

sentences.zh: 明兵二千人至，蘇納領纛進擊，敗之，乘勝逐敵，多所俘斬，獲馬百五十。

translations.literal: When two thousand Ming troops arrived, Suna led the standard forward in attack, defeated them, pursued the enemy on the momentum, captured and killed many, and seized a hundred fifty horses.
translations.idiomatic: When two thousand Ming troops arrived, Suna led the banner forward, routed them, pursued the fugitives, took many captives and heads, and seized a hundred fifty horses.

sentences.zh: 三年春，命與武納格將兵伐察哈爾，以殺降見詰責。

translations.literal: In spring of the third year he was ordered with Wu Nage to lead troops against Chahar and was reprimanded for killing those who had surrendered.
translations.idiomatic: In the spring of the third year he and Wu Nage were ordered to lead troops against Chahar and were rebuked for killing those who had surrendered.

sentences.zh: 十月，復與武納格將兵逐蒙古亡去者。

translations.literal: In the tenth month he again joined Wu Nage in leading troops to pursue Mongols who had fled.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth month he again joined Wu Nage in pursuing Mongols who had fled.

sentences.zh: 語並見武納格傳。

translations.literal: The account is also given in Wu Nage's biography.
translations.idiomatic: The full account appears in the biography of Wu Nage.

sentences.zh: 五年，授擺牙喇纛章京，擢兵部承政。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was appointed bayalara d-ai janggin and promoted to cheng zheng of the Ministry of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was made bayalara standard-bearer janggin and promoted to cheng zheng of the Ministry of War.

sentences.zh: 從伐明，圍大凌河城，敗城兵及錦州援兵，授備禦世職。

translations.literal: Following the campaign against Ming, they besieged Dalinghe city, defeated the garrison and Jinzhou relief troops, and he was granted a hereditary Defender of the State post.
translations.idiomatic: On the Ming campaign he helped besiege Dalinghe, routed the garrison and Jinzhou relief, and was granted a hereditary Defender of the State rank.

sentences.zh: 八年，考滿，進三等甲喇章京，免徭役。

translations.literal: In the eighth year, at completion of his term of service, he was advanced to third-rank jalan janggin and exempted from corvée.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, when his term was complete, he was advanced to third-rank jalan janggin and exempted from corvée labor.

sentences.zh: 九年，以隱匿壯丁，削世職。

translations.literal: In the ninth year, for concealing able-bodied males, his hereditary rank was stripped.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was stripped of his hereditary rank for concealing able-bodied men.

sentences.zh: 七月，定蒙古旗制，以蘇納領鑲白旗。

translations.literal: In the seventh month the Mongol banner system was established and Suna was put in charge of the Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month, when the Mongol banner system was fixed, Suna was placed in command of the Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，從武英郡王阿濟格伐明，薄明都，攻鵰鶚、長安、昌平諸城隘，五十六戰皆捷；

translations.literal: In Chongde 1 he followed Prince Ying Ajige against Ming, pressed near the Ming capital, attacked the passes of Diaoge, Chang'an, Changping, and other cities—fifty-six battles all victorious;
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 1 he followed Prince Ying Ajige against the Ming, pressed toward the capital, and stormed the passes at Diaoge, Chang'an, Changping, and elsewhere—fifty-six engagements, all won;

sentences.zh: 復與薩穆什喀共攻容城，克之。

translations.literal: Again with Samushka he jointly attacked Rongcheng and took it.
translations.idiomatic: He then joined Samushka in attacking Rongcheng and captured it.

sentences.zh: 師還，以先出邊，後隊為敵乘，潰敗，奪所俘獲。

translations.literal: On the army's return, because he had crossed the border ahead and the rear column was taken advantage of by the enemy and routed, his captives were confiscated.
translations.idiomatic: On the return march he had crossed the frontier ahead of the main body; the rear was struck by the enemy and broken, and his spoils were taken away.

sentences.zh: 十二月，從伐朝鮮，朝鮮將以步騎兵千餘禦戰，蘇納及吳塔齊等邀擊，大破之，俘其將。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he followed the Korean campaign; a Korean general met them with more than a thousand infantry and cavalry; Suna and Wutaqi and others intercepted and greatly defeated them, capturing their general.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he joined the Korean campaign. A Korean commander met them with more than a thousand foot and horse; Suna, Wutaqi, and others intercepted them, routed them, and took their general captive.

sentences.zh: 二年，吏議蘇納坐朝鮮國王朝行在，亂班釋甲，又離大軍先還，論罰。

translations.literal: In the second year the ministry deliberated that Suna, during the Korean king's audience at the traveling palace, had disrupted the ranks and doffed armor, and had also left the main army to return first—penalty was assessed.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year the ministry found Suna guilty of disordering the ranks and laying aside armor during the Korean king's audience at the traveling palace, and of leaving the main army to return first; penalties were assessed.

sentences.zh: 三年，又坐有所徇隱，論罰，罷固山額真，仍領牛錄。

translations.literal: In the third year he was again judged for partial concealment, penalty assessed, removed as gushan ejen but still leading his niru.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was again punished for concealment, dismissed as gushan ejen, but continued to lead his niru.

sentences.zh: 順治五年，卒。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Shunzhi he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in Shunzhi 5.

sentences.zh: 世祖追錄蘇納舊勞，復原職。

translations.literal: Shizu posthumously recorded Suna's old merit and restored his former office.
translations.idiomatic: Shizu recalled Suna's earlier service and restored his former rank.

sentences.zh: 子蘇克薩哈，自有傳。

translations.literal: His son Sukesaha has a separate biography.
translations.idiomatic: His son Sukesaha has his own biography.

sentences.zh: 固三泰歸太祖，太祖妻以女，為額駙。

translations.literal: Gusantai came to Taizu; Taizu gave him a daughter in marriage and made him efuhu.
translations.idiomatic: Gusantai submitted to Taizu, who gave him a daughter in marriage and made him an imperial son-in-law.

sentences.zh: 領牛錄，隸滿洲鑲藍旗。

translations.literal: He led a niru and was assigned to the Manchu Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He commanded a niru and was enrolled in the Manchu Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 從伐明，戰於廣寧，單騎入敵陣，身被數創，戰愈力，師乘之，遂敗敵，授副將世職。

translations.literal: Following the campaign against Ming, he fought at Guangning, entered the enemy line alone on horseback, received several wounds, fought all the harder, and when the army pressed the advantage the enemy was defeated; he was granted a hereditary deputy general post.
translations.idiomatic: On a Ming campaign at Guangning he rode alone into the enemy ranks, took several wounds, and fought all the harder; the army followed his lead and routed the foe, and he was granted a hereditary deputy general rank.

sentences.zh: 太宗即位，為八大臣，領本旗。

translations.literal: When Taizong took the throne, he became one of the eight great ministers and led his banner.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizong ascended the throne, Gusantai became one of the eight great ministers and commanded his banner.

sentences.zh: 天聰元年三月，從貝勒阿敏伐朝鮮有功，師還，上郊勞。

translations.literal: In the third month of Tiancong 1 he followed Beile Amin against Korea with merit; when the army returned the sovereign rewarded them at the suburban greeting.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month of Tiancong 1 he followed Beile Amin against Korea with distinction; on the army's return the sovereign received them with a suburban welcome.

sentences.zh: 三年，上自將伐明，攻遵化，固三泰率本旗兵攻其西南，克之。

translations.literal: In the third year the sovereign personally led a campaign against Ming and attacked Zunhua; Gusantai led his banner troops against the southwest and took it.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year the sovereign led a Ming campaign in person against Zunhua; Gusantai led his banner troops against the southwest and captured it.

sentences.zh: 四年，上命固三泰與達爾漢等助攻昌黎。

translations.literal: In the fourth year the sovereign ordered Gusantai with Daihan and others to join in attacking Changli.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year the sovereign ordered Gusantai, Daihan, and others to join the assault on Changli.

sentences.zh: 語詳達爾漢傳。

translations.literal: The account is given in detail in Daihan's biography.
translations.idiomatic: The details are given in the biography of Daihan.

sentences.zh: 復命與高鴻中、庫爾纏等下灤州，籍其倉庫銀穀以聞。

translations.literal: He was again ordered with Gao Hongzhong, Kurchen, and others to take Luanzhou and inventory its storehouses of silver and grain to report.
translations.idiomatic: He was again ordered with Gao Hongzhong, Kurchen, and others to reduce Luanzhou and report the silver and grain in its storehouses.

sentences.zh: 五年，上幸文館，覽達海所譯武經，因諭群臣曰：「為將當卹士。

translations.literal: In the fifth year the sovereign visited the Literary Institute, perused Dahai's translation of the military classics, and thereupon instructed the ministers: "A general ought to cherish his soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year the sovereign visited the Literary Institute, read Dahai's translation of the military classics, and told the ministers: "A commander must care for his men.

sentences.zh: 朕聞額駙固三泰與敵戰，士有死者，以繩繫其足曳歸，蔑視若此，何以得其死力乎？

translations.literal: I have heard that efuhu Gusantai, fighting the enemy, when soldiers died tied ropes to their feet and dragged them back—such contempt; how can he obtain their utmost loyalty?"
translations.idiomatic: I have heard that when Imperial Son-in-law Gusantai fought the enemy and men fell, he tied ropes to their feet and dragged them back. With such contempt, how can he win their utmost loyalty?"

sentences.zh: 」尋命解固山額真。

translations.literal: He was soon ordered relieved of the post of gushan ejen.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon ordered removed as gushan ejen.

sentences.zh: 九年，詔免徭役，並增賜人戶，俾專領牛錄。

translations.literal: In the ninth year an edict exempted him from corvée and additionally granted households, appointing him to lead the niru exclusively.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year an edict exempted him from corvée, granted him additional households, and left him to command his niru alone.

sentences.zh: 順治初，卒。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Shunzhi he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died early in the Shunzhi reign.

sentences.zh: 子明阿圖。

translations.literal: His son was Mingatu.
translations.idiomatic: His son Mingatu.

sentences.zh: 睿親王多爾袞帥師入關，明阿圖攝梅勒額真為殿。

translations.literal: When Prince Rui Dorgon led the army through the passes, Mingatu acted as meire ejen for the rearguard.
translations.idiomatic: When Prince Rui Dorgon led the army through the passes, Mingatu served as acting meire ejen for the rearguard.

sentences.zh: 累官都察院理事官、鑲藍旗蒙古副都統，授三等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: He rose through offices to councilor of the Censorate and Mongol lieutenant-general of the Bordered Blue Banner, and was granted third-rank adaha hafan.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to councilor of the Censorate and Mongol lieutenant-general of the Bordered Blue Banner, and was granted third-rank adaha hafan.

sentences.zh: 順治八年，卒。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Shunzhi he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in Shunzhi 8.

sentences.zh: 明阿圖子賽弼翰，初為簡親王濟度護衛。

translations.literal: Mingatu's son Saibihan was first a guardsman for Prince Jian Jidu.
translations.idiomatic: Mingatu's son Saibihan first served as a guardsman to Prince Jian Jidu.

sentences.zh: 康熙四年，授護軍參領。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Kangxi he was appointed deputy commander of the guards.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 4 he was appointed deputy commander of the guards.

sentences.zh: 從護軍統領瑚里布西御吳三桂將吳之茂，克陽平、朝陽諸關；

translations.literal: Following Guard Commander Hulibu west against Wu Sangui's general Wu Zhimao, he took Yangping, Chaoyang, and other passes;
translations.idiomatic: He followed Guard Commander Hulibu west against Wu Sangui's general Wu Zhimao and captured Yangping, Chaoyang, and other passes;

sentences.zh: 趨保寧討王輔臣，克秦州。

translations.literal: he hastened to Baoning to punish Wang Fuchen and took Qinzhou.
translations.idiomatic: then pressed on to Baoning against Wang Fuchen and took Qinzhou.

sentences.zh: 從平南將軍賴塔南討鄭錦，戰漳州，敗錦將劉國軒等。

translations.literal: Following Pacifier of the South General Laita south against Zheng Jing, he fought at Zhangzhou and defeated Jing's generals Liu Guoxuan and others.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Pacifier of the South General Laita south against Zheng Jing, fought at Zhangzhou, and routed Jing's generals Liu Guoxuan and others.

sentences.zh: 誅吳世璠，定雲南。

translations.literal: Wu Shifan was executed and Yunnan was pacified.
translations.idiomatic: After Wu Shifan was executed, Yunnan was pacified.

sentences.zh: 累官鑲藍旗滿洲副都統，授拜他喇布勒哈番。

translations.literal: He rose to Manchu lieutenant-general of the Bordered Blue Banner and was granted baitalaburu hafan.
translations.idiomatic: He rose to Manchu lieutenant-general of the Bordered Blue Banner and was granted baitalaburu hafan.

sentences.zh: 二十九年，卒。

translations.literal: In the twenty-ninth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the twenty-ninth year.

sentences.zh: 瑚什布，與固三泰同隸鑲藍旗，領牛錄。

translations.literal: Husibu, together with Gusantai enrolled in the Bordered Blue Banner, led a niru.
translations.idiomatic: Husibu, like Gusantai, was enrolled in the Bordered Blue Banner and commanded a niru.

sentences.zh: 尋任侍衛，兼甲喇額真。

translations.literal: He soon served as bodyguard and concurrently held the post of jalan ejen.
translations.idiomatic: He soon became a bodyguard and also served as jalan ejen.

sentences.zh: 天聰二年，從伐通古索爾和部，身被七創，戰益力，斬敵將，授備禦世職。

translations.literal: In Tiancong 2 he followed the campaign against the Tonggusolho tribe, received seven wounds, fought all the harder, beheaded an enemy general, and was granted a hereditary Defender post.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 2 he campaigned against the Tonggusolho tribe, took seven wounds, fought harder still, slew an enemy general, and was granted a hereditary Defender rank.

sentences.zh: 八年，從伐明，攻大同，與圖魯什等擊敗明總兵祖大弼；

translations.literal: In the eighth year, on a Ming campaign, they attacked Datong; with Tursi and others he defeated Ming zongbing Zu Dabiu;
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year, on a Ming campaign against Datong, he and Tursi and others routed the Ming zongbing Zu Dabiu;

sentences.zh: 攻萬全左衛，擊敗明總兵曹文詔；

translations.literal: attacking Wanquan Left Guard he defeated Ming zongbing Cao Wenchao;
translations.idiomatic: attacked Wanquan Left Guard and defeated the Ming zongbing Cao Wenchao;

sentences.zh: 復設伏邀擊，斬三十餘級，俘四人。

translations.literal: again setting an ambush to intercept, he beheaded more than thirty and captured four.
translations.idiomatic: then laid an ambush, took more than thirty heads, and captured four men.

sentences.zh: 九年，定蒙古旗制，瑚什布領鑲藍旗。

translations.literal: In the ninth year when the Mongol banner system was established, Husibu led the Bordered Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year, when the Mongol banner system was fixed, Husibu was placed in command of the Bordered Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，從武英郡王阿濟格伐明，越明都，克定興。

translations.literal: In Chongde 1 he followed Prince Ying Ajige against Ming, crossed beyond the Ming capital, and took Dingxing.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 1 he followed Prince Ying Ajige against the Ming, passed beyond the capital, and captured Dingxing.

sentences.zh: 師還，部議出邊時不為殿，為敵所乘，士卒戰死者十人，罰白金六百，奪世職，罷固山額真，專領牛錄。

translations.literal: On the army's return, the ministry deliberated that when crossing the border he had not served as rearguard, the enemy took advantage, ten soldiers died in battle—he was fined six hundred taels of silver, stripped of hereditary rank, removed as gushan ejen, and appointed solely to lead his niru.
translations.idiomatic: On the return march the ministry found that he had not served as rearguard when crossing the frontier, allowing the enemy to strike; ten soldiers were killed. He was fined six hundred taels of silver, stripped of his hereditary rank, removed as gushan ejen, and left to command his niru alone.

sentences.zh: 三年，授理籓院副理事官。

translations.literal: In the third year he was appointed associate councilor of the Court of Colonial Affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was appointed associate councilor of the Court of Colonial Affairs.

sentences.zh: 順治四年，复世職。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Shunzhi his hereditary rank was restored.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 4 his hereditary rank was restored.

sentences.zh: 遇恩詔，進二等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: Meeting an amnesty edict, he was advanced to second-rank adaha hafan.
translations.idiomatic: Under an amnesty edict he was advanced to second-rank adaha hafan.

sentences.zh: 七年，卒。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the seventh year.

sentences.zh: 子穆徹納。

translations.literal: His son was Muchena.
translations.idiomatic: His son Muchena.

sentences.zh: 順治間，官護軍參領。

translations.literal: During Shunzhi he held the office of deputy commander of the guards.
translations.idiomatic: During the Shunzhi reign he served as deputy commander of the guards.

sentences.zh: 從豫親王多鐸徵蘇尼特部騰吉思，敗喀爾喀兵。

translations.literal: He followed Prince Yu Dodo in campaigning against Tengjisi of the Sunite tribe and defeated Khalkha troops.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Prince Yu Dodo against Tengjisi of the Sunite tribe and defeated Khalkha forces.

sentences.zh: 從武英親王阿濟格討姜瓖，敗其將劉偉思等；

translations.literal: Following Prince Ying Ajige in punishing Jiang Xiang he defeated his generals Liu Weisi and others;
translations.idiomatic: He followed Prince Ying Ajige against Jiang Xiang and routed his generals Liu Weisi and others;

sentences.zh: 攻寧武關，敗宜孟臣援兵；

translations.literal: attacking Ningwu Pass he defeated Yimengchen's relief troops;
translations.idiomatic: attacked Ningwu Pass and defeated the relief force under Yimengchen;

sentences.zh: 至左衛城，戰於吳家峪。

translations.literal: reaching Zuowei city he fought at Wujiayu.
translations.idiomatic: and at Zuowei city fought at Wujiayu.

sentences.zh: 從靖南將軍珠瑪喇定廣東，敗李定國於新會。

translations.literal: Following Pacifier of the South General Zhumarala in pacifying Guangdong, he defeated Li Dingguo at Xinhui.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Pacifier of the South General Zhumarala in pacifying Guangdong and defeated Li Dingguo at Xinhui.

sentences.zh: 累進三等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly promoted to third-rank adaha hafan.
translations.idiomatic: He was repeatedly advanced to third-rank adaha hafan.

sentences.zh: 十三年，卒。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the thirteenth year.

sentences.zh: 鄂莫克圖，納喇氏。

translations.literal: E Moketu, of the Nara clan.
translations.idiomatic: E Moketu was of the Nara clan.

sentences.zh: 自葉赫歸太祖，隸滿洲正藍旗。

translations.literal: From Yehe he returned to the Taizu, was enrolled in the Manchu Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Coming from Yehe, he submitted to Taizu and was placed in the Manchu Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 初為擺牙喇壯達。

translations.literal: At first he served as bayalara janggin dahū.
translations.idiomatic: He first served as a bayalara company captain.

sentences.zh: 天聰元年正月，從伐朝鮮，克義州。

translations.literal: In the first month of Tiancong 1 he followed the campaign against Korea and took Uiju.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of Tiancong 1 he joined the Korean expedition and captured Uiju.

sentences.zh: 五月，上自將伐明，攻寧遠。

translations.literal: In the fifth month the sovereign personally led a campaign against Ming and attacked Ningyuan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the sovereign personally led an attack on Ming at Ningyuan.

sentences.zh: 明總兵滿桂陣於城東，鄂克莫圖從諸將進戰，殪敵。

translations.literal: Ming zongbing Man Gui arrayed east of the city; Ekemotu followed the generals into battle and annihilated the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: When Ming zongbing Man Gui drew up east of the city, Ekemotu advanced with the other generals and destroyed the enemy.

sentences.zh: 三年，從貝勒岳託伐明，攻保安州，先登，克之，賜號「巴圖魯」，授備禦世職，任甲喇章京。

translations.literal: In the third year he followed Prince Yueto against Ming, attacked Bao'an Prefecture, was first over the wall, took it, was granted the title "Baturu", received a hereditary Defender of the State post, and was appointed jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he followed Prince Yueto against Ming, stormed Bao'an Prefecture, was first over the wall, and took it. He was granted the title Baturu, given a hereditary Defender of the State rank, and appointed colonel of a jalan.

sentences.zh: 八年，從伐黑龍江虎爾哈部，計俘，為諸甲喇章京冠。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he joined the campaign against the Hurka tribes of the Amur, counted captives, and ranked first among all jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he campaigned against the Hurka tribes of the Amur, tallied captives, and stood first among all jalan colonels.

sentences.zh: 崇德二年，復從伐卦爾察部，計俘如伐虎爾哈部時。

translations.literal: In Chongde 2 he again joined the campaign against the Gūwalca tribes, counting captives as in the Hurka campaign.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 2 he again campaigned against the Gūwalca tribes and counted captives as he had against the Hurka.

sentences.zh: 三年七月，授兵部理事官。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the third year he was appointed councilor of the Board of War.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the third year he was appointed councilor of the Board of War.

sentences.zh: 九月，從睿親王多爾袞伐明，自青山口入邊，越明都，擊敗明太監馮永盛，克臨潼關，略地至濟南。

translations.literal: In the ninth month he followed Prince Rui Dorgon against Ming, entered the frontier by Qingshan Pass, passed beyond the Ming capital, defeated the Ming eunuch Feng Yongsheng, took Lintong Pass, and raided as far as Jinan.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth month he followed Prince Rui Dorgon against Ming, entered by Qingshan Pass, passed beyond the capital, routed the Ming eunuch Feng Yongsheng, took Lintong Pass, and raided as far as Jinan.

sentences.zh: 四年七月，上遣使如明，命與努山等率兵護使者以行。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fourth year the sovereign sent envoys to Ming and ordered him with Nushan and others to lead troops escorting the envoys on their journey.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fourth year the sovereign sent envoys to Ming and ordered him, with Nushan and others, to escort them with troops.

sentences.zh: 五年，授噶布什賢噶喇昂邦。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was appointed gabsihiyan gūsa i da.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was appointed commander of the brave guards regiment.

sentences.zh: 從伐明，圍錦州，擊敗明總兵祖大壽。

translations.literal: On the Ming campaign they besieged Jinzhou and defeated Ming zongbing Zu Dashou.
translations.idiomatic: On the Ming campaign he helped besiege Jinzhou and defeated the Ming zongbing Zu Dashou.

sentences.zh: 六年，复圍錦州，擊敗明經略洪承疇。

translations.literal: In the sixth year they again besieged Jinzhou and defeated Ming Grand Secretary Hong Chengchou.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year they again invested Jinzhou and routed Ming Grand Secretary Hong Chengchou.

sentences.zh: 語見喀山傳。

translations.literal: The account appears in the biography of Kasan.
translations.idiomatic: The fuller account appears in the biography of Kasan.

sentences.zh: 上軍松山、杏山間，明軍自松山潰遁，騎兵走杏山，步兵走塔山，鄂莫克圖先後邀擊，並有斬獲。

translations.literal: The sovereign's army lay between Songshan and Xingshan; Ming troops broke and fled from Songshan, cavalry toward Xingshan and infantry toward Tashan; E Moketu intercepted them in succession and on both occasions killed and captured.
translations.idiomatic: The sovereign's army lay between Songshan and Xingshan. When Ming forces broke from Songshan, cavalry fled toward Xingshan and infantry toward Tashan. E Moketu intercepted them in turn and took heads and prisoners on both routes.

sentences.zh: 七年，復從圍杏山，分兵略寧遠，掠牲畜。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he again joined the siege of Xingshan, detached troops to raid Ningyuan, and drove off livestock.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he again joined the siege of Xingshan, sent detachments to raid Ningyuan, and carried off livestock.

sentences.zh: 明總兵吳三桂以兵躡我師後，我師擊之，敗走，复益兵覘我師壘，鄂莫克圖與戰，窮追至連山，敵騎自沙河犯我師牧地，复奮擊破之。

translations.literal: Ming zongbing Wu Sangui followed close behind our army with troops; our army struck and put them to flight; they again added troops to spy on our stockades; E Moketu fought them, pursued relentlessly to Lianshan; enemy cavalry from Shahe violated our pasturelands and he again fought fiercely and broke them.
translations.idiomatic: Ming zongbing Wu Sangui pressed on our rear with troops; we struck and drove him off. He reinforced to scout our camps, and E Moketu fought him, pursuing hard to Lianshan. Enemy cavalry from Shahe then raided our pastures, and he again fought them off.

sentences.zh: 錦州既下，進二等參將。

translations.literal: After Jinzhou had fallen he was advanced to second-rank deputy commander.
translations.idiomatic: After Jinzhou fell he was promoted to second-rank deputy commander.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，從入關，敗賊安肅，追之至慶都。

translations.literal: In Shunzhi 1 he joined the crossing into China, defeated the bandits at Ansu, and pursued them to Qingdu.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1 he crossed into China with the army, routed the rebels at Ansu, and pursued them to Qingdu.

sentences.zh: 尋率前鋒兵徇山西，敗賊絳州渡口。

translations.literal: Soon he led vanguard troops through Shanxi, defeated the bandits at the Jiangzhou ford.
translations.idiomatic: Soon he led the vanguard through Shanxi and defeated the rebels at the Jiangzhou crossing.

sentences.zh: 二年，從英親王阿濟格定陝西，敗賊延安。

translations.literal: In the second year he followed Prince Ying Ajige in pacifying Shaanxi and defeated the bandits at Yan'an.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year he followed Prince Ying Ajige in pacifying Shaanxi and defeated the rebels at Yan'an.

sentences.zh: 李自成走湖廣，追之至安陸，屢破賊壘，得戰艦三十，授一等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: Li Zicheng fled to Huguang; they pursued him to Anlu, repeatedly stormed bandit stockades, seized thirty war junks, and he was appointed first-rank jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: Li Zicheng fled into Huguang; they pursued him to Anlu, repeatedly stormed his camps, and seized thirty war junks. He was appointed first-rank jalan colonel.

sentences.zh: 三年，從肅親王豪格下四川，敗賊漢中。

translations.literal: In the third year he followed Prince Su Haoge into Sichuan and defeated the bandits at Hanzhong.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he followed Prince Su Haoge into Sichuan and defeated the rebels at Hanzhong.

sentences.zh: 逐張獻忠至西充，與護軍統領白爾赫圖等屢戰皆捷，加授半個前程。

translations.literal: Pursuing Zhang Xianzhong to Xichong, with Chief Guard Bairehetu and others he fought repeatedly and won every engagement; he received an added half regular stipend.
translations.idiomatic: Pursuing Zhang Xianzhong to Xichong, he fought repeatedly with Chief Guard Bairehetu and others and won every battle. He was granted half a regular stipend in addition.

sentences.zh: 遇恩詔，進一等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: Meeting an amnesty edict, he was advanced to first-rank ashan-i hafan.
translations.idiomatic: Under an amnesty edict he was advanced to first-rank ashan-i hafan.

sentences.zh: 十一年，授正藍旗滿洲副都統。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he was appointed Manchu lieutenant-general of the Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he was appointed Manchu lieutenant-general of the Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 十三年，致仕。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year he retired from office.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year he retired from office.

sentences.zh: 康熙十二年，卒，年七十八。

translations.literal: In Kangxi 12 he died, aged seventy-eight.
translations.idiomatic: He died in Kangxi 12, aged seventy-eight.

sentences.zh: 乾隆初，定封一等男。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Qianlong his enfeoffment was fixed as first-class baron.
translations.idiomatic: Early in the Qianlong reign his hereditary title was fixed as first-class baron.

sentences.zh: 喀山，納喇氏，世居蘇完。

translations.literal: Kasan, of the Nara clan, for generations dwelt at Suwan.
translations.idiomatic: Kasan, of the Nara clan, had lived at Suwan for generations.

sentences.zh: 當葉赫未滅，挈家歸太祖，隸滿洲鑲藍旗，授牛錄額真。

translations.literal: While Yehe had not yet been destroyed he brought his family to submit to the Taizu, was enrolled in the Manchu Bordered Blue Banner, and was appointed niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: Before Yehe was destroyed he brought his household to Taizu, was placed in the Manchu Bordered Blue Banner, and appointed niru captain.

sentences.zh: 屢從伐明，下遼、瀋有功，予游擊世職。

translations.literal: He repeatedly joined Ming campaigns, took Liaodong and Shenyang with merit, and was given a hereditary patrol-commander post.
translations.idiomatic: He repeatedly campaigned against Ming, helped take Liaodong and Shenyang, and was granted a hereditary patrol-commander rank.

sentences.zh: 天命九年，明總兵毛文龍以兵百人劫額駙康果禮莊，喀山率所部御之，斬二裨將，殲其眾。

translations.literal: In Tianming 9 Ming zongbing Mao Wenlong with a hundred men raided the estate of the princess consort Kangguo; Kasan led his command to resist, beheaded two sub-generals, and annihilated their force.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianming 9 the Ming zongbing Mao Wenlong raided the estate of Princess Consort Kangguo with a hundred men. Kasan led his command against them, slew two sub-generals, and wiped out the raiders.

sentences.zh: 天聰六年，從伐察哈爾，與勞薩、吳拜率精銳前驅。

translations.literal: In Tiancong 6 he joined the campaign against Chahar; with Lao'a and Wubai he led elite troops as vanguard.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 6 he campaigned against Chahar and, with Lao'a and Wubai, led picked troops in the van.

sentences.zh: 林丹汗遁走。

translations.literal: Lind Khan fled in defeat.
translations.idiomatic: Lind Khan fled in defeat.

sentences.zh: 八年，進三等梅勒章京。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was advanced to third-rank meiren-i janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was promoted to third-rank meiren colonel.

sentences.zh: 目失明，辭牛錄。

translations.literal: His eyes failed and he resigned his niru.
translations.idiomatic: When his sight failed he resigned his niru command.

sentences.zh: 順治初，進二等昂邦章京。

translations.literal: In early Shunzhi he was advanced to second-rank amban-i janggin.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Shunzhi he was promoted to second-rank amban colonel.

sentences.zh: 尋改二等精奇尼哈番。

translations.literal: Soon it was changed to second-rank jingqini hafan.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the title was changed to second-rank jingqini hafan.

sentences.zh: 十二年，卒，諡敏壯。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he died; posthumous name Minzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the twelfth year and was given the posthumous name Minzhuang.

sentences.zh: 子納海。

translations.literal: His son was Nahai.
translations.idiomatic: His son Nahai.

sentences.zh: 初以喀山病目，命代領牛錄。

translations.literal: At first because Kasan's eyes were diseased he was ordered to take charge of the niru in his stead.
translations.idiomatic: Because Kasan's eyes had failed, he was first ordered to command the niru in his father's place.

sentences.zh: 旋授噶布什賢甲喇額真。

translations.literal: He was soon appointed gabsihiyan jalan ejen.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon appointed colonel of the brave guards.

sentences.zh: 從伐明，與席特庫等以步兵四千擊敗明陽和騎兵，斬級二百，獲馬六十餘；

translations.literal: On Ming campaigns, with Siteku and others, he led four thousand foot soldiers to defeat Ming Yanghe cavalry, beheading two hundred and taking more than sixty horses;
translations.idiomatic: On Ming campaigns he and Siteku and others led four thousand foot soldiers against Ming Yanghe cavalry, took two hundred heads, and seized more than sixty horses;

sentences.zh: 復設伏宣府，捕明邏騎。

translations.literal: again he set an ambush at Xuanfu and captured Ming border patrols.
translations.idiomatic: then laid an ambush at Xuanfu and captured Ming border patrols.

sentences.zh: 天聰九年，復從伐明，攻大同，命與布丹等駐上都城故址，诇軍事。

translations.literal: In Tiancong 9 he again joined the Ming campaign, attacked Datong, and was ordered with Budan and others to garrison the old site of Shangdu to reconnoiter military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 9 he again campaigned against Ming and attacked Datong. He was ordered with Budan and others to garrison the ruins of Shangdu and scout enemy movements.

sentences.zh: 尋命與鄂莫克圖等齎書諭明邊守將，歷喜峰口、潘家口、董家口諸隘，及還，斬邏卒百餘。

translations.literal: He was soon ordered with E Moketu and others to carry letters instructing Ming border commanders, passing the passes Xifengkou, Panjiakou, Dongjiakou and others; on the return march they beheaded more than a hundred border soldiers.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon ordered with E Moketu and others to carry dispatches to Ming border commanders, passing Xifengkou, Panjiakou, Dongjiakou, and other passes. On the return march they slew more than a hundred border troops.

sentences.zh: 崇德二年，命與席特庫齎書諭明錦州守將祖大壽，自廣寧入邊，獲邏卒十二，斬其九，縱二人使齎諭以往，俘一人以還。

translations.literal: In Chongde 2 he was ordered with Siteku to carry letters instructing Zu Dashou, Jinzhou garrison commander of Ming; entering the frontier from Guangning they captured twelve border soldiers, beheaded nine, released two to bear the message, and brought back one captive.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 2 he and Siteku were ordered to carry letters to Zu Dashou, the Ming commander at Jinzhou. Entering from Guangning they seized twelve border troops, executed nine, released two to deliver the message, and brought one prisoner back.

sentences.zh: 四年，從武英郡王阿濟格伐明錦州，還報捷。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he followed Prince Ying Ajige against Ming at Jinzhou and returned reporting victory.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he followed Prince Ying Ajige against Jinzhou and returned with news of victory.

sentences.zh: 復從上攻松山，明兵出戰，擊卻之。

translations.literal: He again joined the attack on Songshan; Ming troops came out to fight and were driven back.
translations.idiomatic: He again joined the assault on Songshan, drove back Ming troops who came out to fight, and put them to flight.

sentences.zh: 祖大壽遣兵自寧遠乘舟趨杏山，將入城；

translations.literal: Zu Dashou sent troops from Ningyuan by boat toward Xingshan, about to enter the city;
translations.idiomatic: Zu Dashou sent men from Ningyuan by boat toward Xingshan, about to enter the city;

sentences.zh: 納海與瑚密色、索渾將兵擊其後，斬級五十，獲甲四十、舟一。

translations.literal: Nahai with Homise, Suohun and others led troops to strike them from behind, beheading fifty, seizing forty sets of armor and one boat.
translations.idiomatic: Nahai, with Homise, Suohun, and others, struck them from the rear, took fifty heads, and seized forty suits of armor and one boat.

sentences.zh: 又與瑚密色、席特庫等行略地，俘採薪者二十二人，牛、羊、騾馬無算。

translations.literal: Again with Homise, Siteku and others he raided the countryside, capturing twenty-two wood-gatherers and untold cattle, sheep, mules and horses.
translations.idiomatic: Again, with Homise, Siteku, and others, he raided the countryside, took twenty-two wood-gatherers prisoner, and seized countless cattle, sheep, mules, and horses.

sentences.zh: 五年，從伐明，圍錦州，敵築台城外，納海與色赫、布丹、蘇爾德將騎兵馳擊，斬四十人，复逐斬刈草者四十二人，敵來犯，屢擊卻之。

translations.literal: In the fifth year on the Ming campaign they besieged Jinzhou; the enemy built towers outside the walls; Nahai with Sehe, Budan and Surde led cavalry in a dash attack, beheading forty; again pursuing they cut down forty-two grass-cutters; when the enemy attacked they repeatedly drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year, on the Ming campaign, they besieged Jinzhou while the enemy built towers outside the walls. Nahai, with Sehe, Budan, and Surde, led a cavalry charge and slew forty men, then ran down forty-two foragers. Whenever the enemy attacked, they repeatedly drove them back.

sentences.zh: 與色赫等略小凌河，斬祖大壽所遣蒙古十七人。

translations.literal: With Sehe and others he raided the Xiaoling River and beheaded seventeen Mongols sent by Zu Dashou.
translations.idiomatic: With Sehe and others he raided the Xiaoling River and slew seventeen Mongols sent by Zu Dashou.

sentences.zh: 六年，明總督洪承疇集各道兵赴援，次松山，與吳拜擊敗其騎兵。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Ming Governor-General Hong Chengchou assembled troops from all circuits to relieve the siege and encamped at Songshan; with Wubai he defeated the cavalry.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Ming Governor-General Hong Chengchou gathered troops from every circuit to relieve the siege and encamped at Songshan. With Wubai he routed the cavalry.

sentences.zh: 上自將攻松山，敵自杏山走塔山，與鄂莫克圖帥師邀擊，追至筆架山，斬級四百，俘二十八，得纛六，獲馬二百餘。

translations.literal: The sovereign personally led the attack on Songshan; the enemy fled from Xingshan toward Tashan; with E Moketu he commanded troops to intercept, pursuing to Bijiashan, beheading four hundred, capturing twenty-eight, taking six banners, and seizing more than two hundred horses.
translations.idiomatic: When the sovereign personally assaulted Songshan, the enemy fled from Xingshan toward Tashan. With E Moketu he intercepted them, pursued to Bijiashan, took four hundred heads, captured twenty-eight men, seized six banners, and took more than two hundred horses.

sentences.zh: 七年，錦州下。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Jinzhou fell.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Jinzhou surrendered.

sentences.zh: 敘功，予半個前程，命攝噶布什賢噶喇昂邦。

translations.literal: When merit was assessed he was granted half a regular stipend and ordered to act as gabsihiyan gūsa i da.
translations.idiomatic: For his services he received half a regular stipend and was ordered to act as commander of the brave guards regiment.

sentences.zh: 從貝勒阿巴泰伐明，自黃崖口入長城，趨薊州，敗明總兵白騰蛟、白廣恩，遂略山東。

translations.literal: He followed Prince Abatai against Ming, entered the Great Wall by Huangyakou, pressed toward Jizhou, defeated Ming zongbing Bai Tengjiao and Bai Guang'en, and then raided Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Prince Abatai against Ming, entered the Great Wall at Huangyakou, marched on Jizhou, defeated the Ming zongbing Bai Tengjiao and Bai Guang'en, and then raided Shandong.

sentences.zh: 明年，師還。

translations.literal: The next year the army returned.
translations.idiomatic: The following year the army returned.

sentences.zh: 以右翼諸將不俟左翼軍至，先出邊，功不敘。

translations.literal: Because the right-wing generals crossed the border before the left-wing army arrived, merit was not recorded.
translations.idiomatic: Because the right-wing generals had crossed the frontier before the left wing arrived, their merit went unrecorded.

sentences.zh: 順治初，遇恩詔，進三等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: In early Shunzhi, meeting an amnesty edict, he was advanced to third-rank adaha hafan.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Shunzhi, under an amnesty edict, he was advanced to third-rank adaha hafan.

sentences.zh: 及喀山卒，兼襲二等精奇尼哈番，例進二等伯。

translations.literal: When Kasan died he also inherited second-rank jingqini hafan, and by statute was advanced to second-rank baron.
translations.idiomatic: When Kasan died he also inherited the second-rank jingqini hafan and, by statute, was raised to second-rank baron.

sentences.zh: 雍正中，從孫奇山，降襲一等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: In the Yongzheng era his collateral descendant Qishan had the succession reduced to first-rank ashan-i hafan.
translations.idiomatic: In the Yongzheng era his collateral descendant Qishan had the inherited rank reduced to first-rank ashan-i hafan.

sentences.zh: 乾隆元年，定封一等男。

translations.literal: In Qianlong 1 the enfeoffment was fixed as first-class baron.
translations.idiomatic: In Qianlong 1 the hereditary title was fixed as first-class baron.

sentences.zh: 安達立，納喇氏。

translations.literal: Andali, of the Nara clan.
translations.idiomatic: Andali was of the Nara clan.

sentences.zh: 自葉赫歸太祖，隸滿洲正紅旗。

translations.literal: From Yehe he returned to the Taizu and was enrolled in the Manchu Plain Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: Coming from Yehe, he submitted to Taizu and was placed in the Manchu Plain Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 太祖遣兵徇鐵嶺，刈其禾，有蒙古人降於明，出拒，安達立擊之走。

translations.literal: Taizu sent troops to secure Tieling and reap its grain; some Mongols who had defected to Ming came out to resist, and Andali attacked and put them to flight.
translations.idiomatic: Taizu sent troops to secure Tieling and harvest its grain. Some Mongols who had gone over to the Ming came out to resist, and Andali attacked and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 事太宗，從貝勒薩哈璘駐牛莊。

translations.literal: Serving Taizong, he followed Prince Sahalian to garrison Niuzhuang.
translations.idiomatic: Under Taizong he followed Prince Sahalian to garrison Niuzhuang.

sentences.zh: 師攻永平，葉臣率二十四人冒矢石先登，安達立其一也。

translations.literal: When the army attacked Yongping, Yechen led twenty-four men who braved arrows and stones to be first over the wall; Andali was one of them.
translations.idiomatic: When the army attacked Yongping, Yechen led twenty-four men who braved arrows and stones to scale the wall first; Andali was among them.

sentences.zh: 師還，從圖魯什偵敵建昌，夜戰，甲士有中矢墜馬者，援之出，擢噶布什賢章京。

translations.literal: On the army's return he followed Tursi to scout the enemy at Jianchang; in night fighting an armored soldier was struck by an arrow and fell from his horse; he rescued him and was promoted to gabsihiyan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: On the return march he followed Tursi to scout the enemy at Jianchang. In a night battle an armored soldier was struck by an arrow and fell from his horse; he pulled him out and was promoted to colonel of the brave guards.

sentences.zh: 從伐明，攻崞縣，率所部先登；

translations.literal: On the Ming campaign he attacked Guo County and led his command in being first over the wall;
translations.idiomatic: On the Ming campaign he attacked Guo County and led his command over the wall first;

sentences.zh: 復以四十人伏忻口，敗敵，得纛三、馬五十餘。

translations.literal: again with forty men he ambushed at Xin Pass, defeated the enemy, and seized three banners and more than fifty horses.
translations.idiomatic: then with forty men ambushed at Xin Pass, routed the enemy, and seized three banners and more than fifty horses.

sentences.zh: 出邊，圖爾格擊敵潰竄，安達立邀擊，迫敵入壕，所殺傷過當。

translations.literal: Crossing the border, when Turgut struck the fleeing enemy, Andali intercepted them, pressing the enemy into ditches; those killed and wounded exceeded his own numbers.
translations.idiomatic: On the frontier, when Turgut struck the fleeing enemy, Andali intercepted them and drove them into ditches, killing and wounding far more than his own losses.

sentences.zh: 天聰九年，授牛錄章京世職，擢正紅旗蒙古梅勒額真。

translations.literal: In Tiancong 9 he was granted a hereditary niru janggin rank and promoted to Mongol meiren-i ejen of the Plain Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 9 he was granted the hereditary rank of niru colonel and promoted to Mongol meiren commander of the Plain Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 崇德三年，從貝勒岳託伐明，將至牆子嶺，聞明軍備甚固，安達立與固山額真恩格圖率所部趨嶺右，陟高峰間​​道入邊，擊敗明軍。

translations.literal: In Chongde 3 he followed Prince Yueto against Ming; approaching Qiangziling they heard Ming defenses were very strong; Andali with gushan ejen Enggū led his command toward the right of the pass, climbed a hidden path between the peaks to enter the border, and defeated the Ming army.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 3 he followed Prince Yueto against Ming. Near Qiangziling they learned that Ming defenses were very strong. Andali and gushan ejen Enggū led their commands to the right of the pass, climbed a hidden path between the peaks into the frontier, and routed the Ming army.

sentences.zh: 越燕京，略山東。

translations.literal: They passed beyond Yanjing and raided Shandong.
translations.idiomatic: They passed beyond Yanjing and raided Shandong.

sentences.zh: 明年，師自青山口出邊，复擊敗明軍。

translations.literal: The next year the army left the frontier by Qingshan Pass and again defeated Ming troops.
translations.idiomatic: The following year the army withdrew through Qingshan Pass and again defeated Ming forces.

sentences.zh: 五年，圍錦州，屢戰皆捷。

translations.literal: In the fifth year they besieged Jinzhou and won every engagement.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year they besieged Jinzhou and won every battle.

sentences.zh: 六年，复圍錦州，洪承疇援師至，與戰，破三營，至暮，敵潰，翌日復戰，又擊卻之。

translations.literal: In the sixth year they again besieged Jinzhou; Hong Chengchou's relief army arrived; they fought, broke three camps, and at dusk the enemy broke; the next day they fought again and again drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year they again invested Jinzhou. When Hong Chengchou's relief army arrived they gave battle, broke three camps, and by evening the enemy collapsed. The next day they fought again and once more drove them back.

sentences.zh: 敘功，加半個前程。

translations.literal: When merit was assessed he was granted half a regular stipend.
translations.idiomatic: For his services he received half a regular stipend.

sentences.zh: 尋卒。

translations.literal: Soon he died.
translations.idiomatic: He soon died.

sentences.zh: 子阿積賴，襲職。

translations.literal: His son Ajilai inherited the post.
translations.idiomatic: His son Ajilai inherited the office.

sentences.zh: 順治初，從入關，逐李自成，戰於慶都。

translations.literal: In early Shunzhi he joined the crossing into China, pursued Li Zicheng, and fought at Qingdu.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Shunzhi he crossed into China with the army, pursued Li Zicheng, and fought at Qingdu.

sentences.zh: 又從葉臣徇山西，署正紅旗蒙古梅勒額真。

translations.literal: Again he followed Yechen through Shanxi and acted as Mongol meiren-i ejen of the Plain Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He again followed Yechen through Shanxi and served as acting Mongol meiren commander of the Plain Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 又從英親王阿濟格攻延安，逐自成至武昌，竄入九宮山，率師搜剿，殲其徒甚眾。

translations.literal: Again he followed Prince Ying Ajige in attacking Yan'an, pursued Zicheng to Wuchang; Zicheng fled into Jiugong Mountain; he led troops to search and suppress, wiping out a great number of his followers.
translations.idiomatic: He again followed Prince Ying Ajige against Yan'an and pursued Zicheng to Wuchang. When Zicheng fled into Jiugong Mountain he led troops to hunt him down and killed a great many of his followers.

sentences.zh: 四年，兼任刑部理事官。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he concurrently served as councilor of the Board of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he also served as councilor of the Board of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 五年，署巴牙喇纛章京。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he acted as bayalara banner janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he served as acting bayalara banner colonel.

sentences.zh: 從鄭親王濟爾哈朗徵湖南，分兵徇道州，攻永安關。

translations.literal: He followed Prince Zheng Jirhalang on the Hunan expedition, detached troops to secure Daozhou, and attacked Yong'an Pass.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Prince Zheng Jirhalang on the Hunan campaign, sent detachments through Daozhou, and attacked Yong'an Pass.

sentences.zh: 敘功，進一等阿達哈哈番兼拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: When merit was assessed he was advanced to first-rank adaha hafan with the added tosara hafan.
translations.idiomatic: For his services he was promoted to first-rank adaha hafan with the added title of tosara hafan.

sentences.zh: 卒。

translations.literal: He died.
translations.idiomatic: He died.

sentences.zh: 綽拜，巴林氏。

translations.literal: Chuobai, of the Baarin clan.
translations.idiomatic: Chuobai was of the Baarin clan.

sentences.zh: 自葉赫歸太祖，隸蒙古鑲白旗，為牛錄額真。

translations.literal: From Yehe he returned to the Taizu, was enrolled in the Mongol Bordered White Banner, and served as niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: Coming from Yehe, he submitted to Taizu, was placed in the Mongol Bordered White Banner, and appointed niru captain.

sentences.zh: 天聰八年，授世職牛錄章京。

translations.literal: In Tiancong 8 he was granted a hereditary niru janggin rank.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 8 he was granted the hereditary rank of niru colonel.

sentences.zh: 九年，與吳巴海伐瓦爾喀部，深入額赫庫倫、額埒岳索諸地，進三等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: In the ninth year with Wu Bahai he campaigned against the Warka tribes, penetrating deeply into Ehekulun, Eleyuesuo and other places, and was advanced to third-rank jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he campaigned with Wu Bahai against the Warka tribes, penetrating deep into Ehekulun, Eleyuesuo, and other regions, and was promoted to third-rank jalan colonel.

sentences.zh: 崇德三年，兼任戶部理事官。

translations.literal: In Chongde 3 he concurrently served as councilor of the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Chongde he also served as councilor of the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 從睿親王多爾袞伐明，徇山東，至濟南，敵騎千餘拒戰，何洛會先眾奮擊，遂克其城。

translations.literal: He followed Prince Rui Dorgon on the Ming campaign, swept through Shandong, and reached Jinan; more than a thousand enemy horsemen resisted; Heluohei led the host in a fierce attack, and the city was taken.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Prince Rui Dorgon on the campaign against the Ming, swept through Shandong, and reached Jinan. When more than a thousand enemy horsemen resisted, Heluohei led the van in a fierce assault and the city was taken.

sentences.zh: 七年，從肅親王豪格圍明總督洪承疇於松山，承疇遣兵夜越壕攻鑲黃旗營，擊卻之。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he followed Prince Su Hauge in besieging Ming Grand Coordinator Hong Chengchou at Songshan; Chengchou sent troops by night to cross the moat and attack the Bordered Yellow Banner camp, and they were beaten back.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he followed Prince Su Hauge in besieging Ming Grand Coordinator Hong Chengchou at Songshan. Chengchou sent troops by night to cross the moat and strike the Bordered Yellow Banner camp, and they drove them back.

sentences.zh: 八年，進二等。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was advanced to the second rank.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was promoted to the second rank.

sentences.zh: 順治初，從入關，破流賊，進一等。

translations.literal: In early Shunzhi he joined the crossing into China, defeated the bandit armies, and was advanced to the first rank.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Shunzhi he crossed the pass with the army, routed the rebel bands, and was promoted to the first rank.

sentences.zh: 四年，加拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was granted the added title of tosara hafan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he received the added rank of tosara hafan.

sentences.zh: 五年，授參領。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was appointed canling.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was appointed regimental adjutant (canling).

sentences.zh: 從征南大將軍譚泰討叛將金聲桓，克饒州、南昌，師還，賚白金千、馬四十。

translations.literal: He followed the Pacification-of-the-South Grand General Tan Tai in suppressing the rebel Jin Shenghuan, took Raozhou and Nanchang, and on the army's return was rewarded with a thousand taels of white silver and forty horses.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Grand General Tan Tai of the southern expedition against the rebel Jin Shenghuan, captured Raozhou and Nanchang, and on the army's return was rewarded with a thousand taels of silver and forty horses.

sentences.zh: 七年，遷倉場侍郎。

translations.literal: In the seventh year he was transferred to Vice President of the Granary Bureau.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he was made Vice President of the Granary Bureau.

sentences.zh: 八年，授鑲白旗蒙古梅勒額真，兼工部侍郎。

translations.literal: In the eighth year he was appointed Mongol meiren-i ejen of the Bordered White Banner and concurrently Vice President of the Board of Works.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he was appointed Mongol meiren commander of the Bordered White Banner and also served as Vice President of the Board of Works.

sentences.zh: 擢本旗固山額真，進一等阿思哈尼哈番。

translations.literal: He was promoted to gūsa i da of his banner and advanced to first-rank ashan i hafan.
translations.idiomatic: He was promoted to banner commander of his own banner and advanced to first-rank ashan i hafan.

sentences.zh: 九年十二月，卒。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month of the ninth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the twelfth month of the ninth year.

sentences.zh: 布丹，富察氏。

translations.literal: Budan, of the Fuca clan.
translations.idiomatic: Budan was of the Fuca clan.

sentences.zh: 自葉赫歸太祖，隸滿洲正紅旗，授牛錄額真。

translations.literal: From Yehe he returned to the Taizu, was enrolled in the Manchu Plain Red Banner, and was appointed niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: Coming from Yehe, he submitted to Taizu, was placed in the Manchu Plain Red Banner, and appointed niru captain.

sentences.zh: 尋遷甲喇額真，領擺牙喇兵。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to jalan ejen and commanded bayalara troops.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon made jalan commander and led bayalara troops.

sentences.zh: 天聰八年，從伐明，克萬全左衛城，先登，授半個前程。

translations.literal: In Tiancong 8 he joined the Ming campaign, took Wanquan Left Guard city, was first over the wall, and was granted half a regular stipend.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 8 he campaigned against the Ming, captured Wanquan Left Guard city, was first over the wall, and received half a regular stipend.

sentences.zh: 九年，從貝勒多鐸伐明，攻錦州，師還，明兵驟至，固山額真石廷柱所部有陷陣不能出者，布丹破陣援之出。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he followed Prince Dodo against Ming and attacked Jinzhou; on the army's return Ming troops suddenly arrived; among the troops of gūsa i da Shi Tingzhu some were trapped in the battle line and could not get out, and Budan broke the enemy formation and rescued them.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he followed Prince Dodo against the Ming and attacked Jinzhou. On the return march Ming troops suddenly appeared. Some of Banner Commander Shi Tingzhu's men were trapped in the enemy line and could not break out; Budan smashed the formation and brought them out.

sentences.zh: 旋命與納海等诇軍事。

translations.literal: He was soon ordered with Nahai and others to reconnoiter military affairs.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon ordered, together with Nahai and others, to scout enemy dispositions.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，從武英郡王阿濟格伐明，破鵰鶚、長安二隘，皆先登，與蘇納同功。

translations.literal: In Chongde 1 he followed Prince Wuying Ajige against Ming, broke the Diaoe and Chang'an passes, was first over the wall in both, and shared merit with Suna.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chongde he followed Prince Wuying Ajige against the Ming, stormed the Diaoe and Chang'an passes, was first over the wall in both assaults, and shared credit with Suna.

sentences.zh: 轉戰至涿州，師還，明兵出居庸關，設伏邀我軍輜重，擊破之。

translations.literal: Fighting on to Zhuozhou, on the army's return Ming troops came out through Juyong Pass, laid an ambush to intercept our baggage train, and were defeated.
translations.idiomatic: The campaign carried on to Zhuozhou. On the return march Ming troops came out through Juyong Pass and set an ambush to cut off our baggage train; they were defeated.

sentences.zh: 四年，與沙爾瑚達等將土默特兵二百，略寧遠北境，以數騎挑戰，敵堅壁不出，乃俘其樵者以歸。

translations.literal: In the fourth year with Sharhuda and others he led two hundred Tümed troops to raid the northern border of Ningyuan; with a few horsemen he offered challenge, but the enemy held their walls and would not come out, so he captured their woodcutters and returned.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he joined Sharhuda and others in leading two hundred Tümed troops on a raid into the country north of Ningyuan. He provoked the enemy with a few horsemen, but they held their walls and refused battle, so he seized their woodcutters and withdrew.

sentences.zh: 五年，圍錦州，殺敵。

translations.literal: In the fifth year they besieged Jinzhou and killed the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year they besieged Jinzhou and killed many of the enemy.

sentences.zh: 語見納海傳。

translations.literal: The account is given in the biography of Nahai.
translations.idiomatic: The details appear in the biography of Nahai.

sentences.zh: 六年，與明兵戰松山、杏山，屢勝。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he fought Ming troops at Songshan and Xingshan and won repeatedly.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he fought the Ming at Songshan and Xingshan and won battle after battle.

sentences.zh: 錦州下，進牛錄章京世職。

translations.literal: When Jinzhou fell he was advanced to the hereditary rank of niru janggin.
translations.idiomatic: After Jinzhou fell he was promoted to the hereditary rank of niru colonel.

sentences.zh: 七年冬，復與

translations.literal: In the winter of the seventh year he again joined
translations.idiomatic: In the winter of the seventh year he again joined

sentences.zh: 納海等從貝勒阿巴泰伐明。

translations.literal: Nahai and others in following Prince Abatai against Ming.
translations.idiomatic: Nahai and others in following Prince Abatai on the campaign against the Ming.

sentences.zh: 順治初，從入關，破流賊。

translations.literal: In early Shunzhi he joined the crossing into China and defeated the bandit armies.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Shunzhi he crossed the pass with the army and routed the rebel bands.

sentences.zh: 敘功，並遇恩詔，進一等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: When merit was assessed, and with the grace edict as well, he was advanced to first-rank adaha hafan.
translations.idiomatic: For his services, and with the benefit of a grace edict as well, he was promoted to first-rank adaha hafan.

sentences.zh: 九年，擢正紅旗蒙古副都統。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he was promoted to Mongol vice lieutenant-general of the Plain Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he was made Mongol vice lieutenant-general of the Plain Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 十一年，卒，諡毅勤。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he died; his posthumous title was Yiqin.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the eleventh year and was given the posthumous title Yiqin.

sentences.zh: 孫達哩，魯布哩氏。

translations.literal: Sundali, of the Luburi clan.
translations.idiomatic: Sundali was of the Luburi clan.

sentences.zh: 太祖取葉赫，以其民分屬八旗，孫達哩隸正黃旗。

translations.literal: When the Taizu took Yehe he distributed its people among the Eight Banners; Sundali was enrolled in the Plain Yellow Banner.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizu conquered Yehe he assigned its people among the Eight Banners; Sundali was placed in the Plain Yellow Banner.

sentences.zh: 選充驍騎，遇戰必先，中創不為卻，屢得優賚。

translations.literal: Chosen as a brave horseman, in battle he always went first; though wounded he would not retreat, and he repeatedly received generous rewards.
translations.idiomatic: Selected as a brave horseman, he always led the charge; even when wounded he would not fall back, and he was repeatedly rewarded with special gifts.

sentences.zh: 崇德三年，從睿親王多爾袞伐明，入自青山口，越明都，轉戰至山東，攻濟南，先登第一，賜號「巴圖魯」，授二等參將，領牛錄額真。

translations.literal: In Chongde 3 he followed Prince Rui Dorgon against Ming, entered through Qingshankou, passed the Ming capital, fought on to Shandong, attacked Jinan, was first over the wall, was granted the title "Baturu", appointed second-rank colonel, and made niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Chongde he followed Prince Rui Dorgon against the Ming, entered through Qingshankou, marched past the Ming capital, and fought on into Shandong. At Jinan he was first over the wall, was granted the title Baturu, made second-rank colonel, and appointed niru captain.

sentences.zh: 順治間，累進二等阿思哈尼哈番，遷擺牙喇纛章京。

translations.literal: During Shunzhi he was repeatedly advanced to second-rank ashan i hafan and transferred to bayalara banner janggin.
translations.idiomatic: During the Shunzhi reign he rose step by step to second-rank ashan i hafan and was made colonel of the bayalara banner.

sentences.zh: 從穆里瑪、圖海討李自成餘黨李來亨、袁宗第等，破茅麓山，有功。

translations.literal: He followed Muli Ma and Tuhai in suppressing Li Zicheng's remnant followers Li Laiheng, Yuan Zongdi, and others, broke Maolu Mountain, and rendered merit.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Muli Ma and Tuhai against the survivors of Li Zicheng's cause—Li Laiheng, Yuan Zongdi, and others—stormed Maolu Mountain, and distinguished himself.

sentences.zh: 十二年，加太子少傅。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year he was given the added title Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth year he was made Junior Tutor of the Heir Apparent.

sentences.zh: 十四年四月，卒，諡果壯。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the fourteenth year he died; his posthumous title was Guozhuang.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the fourth month of the fourteenth year and was given the posthumous title Guozhuang.

sentences.zh: 吉思哈，烏蘇氏，世居瓦爾喀馮佳屯。

translations.literal: Jisiha, of the Wusu clan, had for generations lived at Warka Fengjia tun.
translations.idiomatic: Jisiha was of the Wusu clan and his family had long lived at Warka Fengjia tun.

sentences.zh: 初屬烏喇，見其貝勒不足事，與弟吉普喀達歸太祖，並授牛錄額真，隸滿洲正白旗。

translations.literal: At first he belonged to Ula; seeing that its beile was not worth serving, he and his younger brother Jipukada returned to the Taizu; both were appointed niru ejen and enrolled in the Manchu Plain White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He had first been subject to Ula, but finding its prince unworthy of service he came to Taizu with his younger brother Jipukada. Both were appointed niru captains and placed in the Manchu Plain White Banner.

sentences.zh: 旋改隸鑲白旗。

translations.literal: Soon he was transferred to the Bordered White Banner.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon transferred to the Bordered White Banner.

sentences.zh: 天命四年，從伐明有功，授游擊世職。

translations.literal: In Tianming 4 he followed the Ming campaign with merit and was granted the hereditary rank of guerrilla colonel.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianming 4 he served on the campaign against the Ming with distinction and was granted the hereditary rank of guerrilla colonel.

sentences.zh: 六年，以甲喇額真帥師圍遼陽，樹雲梯先登。

translations.literal: In the sixth year as jalan ejen he led troops to besiege Liaoyang, set scaling ladders, and was first over the wall.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year, as jalan commander, he led troops to besiege Liaoyang, raised scaling ladders, and was first over the wall.

sentences.zh: 天聰八年，太宗追錄其功，進二等參將。

translations.literal: In Tiancong 8 Taizong reviewed his merits posthumously and advanced him to second-rank colonel.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 8 Taizong reviewed his earlier service and promoted him to second-rank colonel.

sentences.zh: 是年，與甲喇額真吳巴海伐東海虎爾喀部，俘一千五百有奇，及牲畜輜重。

translations.literal: That year with jalan ejen Wu Bahai he campaigned against the Eastern Sea Hurka tribes, taking more than fifteen hundred captives together with livestock and baggage.
translations.idiomatic: That same year he campaigned with Jalan Commander Wu Bahai against the Eastern Sea Hurka tribes, capturing more than fifteen hundred people along with livestock and supplies.

sentences.zh: 九年，與梅勒額真巴奇蘭等伐黑龍江，收二千人以還，進一等參將。

translations.literal: In the ninth year with meiren-i ejen Baqilan and others he campaigned on the Amur, brought back two thousand people, and was advanced to first-rank colonel.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he joined Meiren Commander Baqilan and others on an Amur campaign, brought back two thousand people, and was promoted to first-rank colonel.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年，太宗自將伐朝鮮，聞明兵入鹼場，遣吉思哈率兵躡其後，擊敗之。

translations.literal: In Chongde 1 Taizong personally led a campaign against Korea; hearing that Ming troops had entered Jianchang, he sent Jisiha with troops to follow on their rear and defeated them.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Chongde Taizong personally led an invasion of Korea. When he learned that Ming troops had entered Jianchang, he sent Jisiha with a force to trail them and defeated them.

sentences.zh: 二年，師既克朝鮮都城，上命旗出甲士十，並簡科爾沁、敖漢、柰曼、扎魯特、烏拉特諸部兵，俾吉思哈及理籓院承政尼堪為將，自朝鮮伐瓦爾喀，因擊破朝鮮軍，斬平壤巡撫，進略瓦爾喀，奏捷稱旨。

translations.literal: In the second year, after the army had taken the Korean capital, the sovereign ordered each banner to furnish ten armored soldiers and also selected troops from the Khorchin, Aohan, Naiman, Jarud, and Urad tribes; Jisiha and Nikhan, cheng zheng of the Court of Colonial Affairs, were made generals to campaign against Warka from Korea; on the way they defeated Korean forces, beheaded the Pacification Commissioner of Pyongyang, advanced against Warka, reported victory, and pleased the sovereign.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, after the army had taken the Korean capital, the sovereign ordered each banner to supply ten armored men and also drafted troops from the Khorchin, Aohan, Naiman, Jarud, and Urad tribes. Jisiha and Nikhan, chief minister of the Court of Colonial Affairs, were appointed generals to strike Warka from Korea. En route they routed Korean forces, killed the Pacification Commissioner of Pyongyang, pressed into Warka, reported victory, and won the sovereign's approval.

sentences.zh: 語詳尼堪傳。

translations.literal: The account is given in full in the biography of Nikhan.
translations.idiomatic: The full account appears in the biography of Nikhan.

sentences.zh: 累遷至吏部參政。

translations.literal: He was repeatedly transferred until he reached the post of cheng zheng of the Board of Civil Appointments.
translations.idiomatic: He rose through successive posts until he became chief minister of the Board of Civil Appointments.

sentences.zh: 三年四月，卒。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the third year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the fourth month of the third year.

sentences.zh: 子吉瞻，襲。

translations.literal: His son Jizhan inherited the post.
translations.idiomatic: His son Jizhan inherited the office.

sentences.zh: 吉普喀達，吉思哈弟也。

translations.literal: Jipukada was Jisiha's younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: Jipukada was the younger brother of Jisiha.

sentences.zh: 天命四年，授游擊。

translations.literal: In Tianming 4 he was appointed guerrilla colonel.
translations.idiomatic: In Tianming 4 he was appointed guerrilla colonel.

sentences.zh: 六年，任甲喇額真。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he served as jalan ejen.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he served as jalan commander.

sentences.zh: 從伐明，攻奉集堡，明總兵李秉誠赴援，師與戰，明兵走入城，師從之，至壕，城上發巨砲，吉普喀達中砲卒。

translations.literal: On the Ming campaign he attacked Fengji Fort; Ming zongbing Li Bingcheng came to the relief; the army fought him; Ming troops ran into the city and the army followed them to the moat; great cannon were fired from the wall; Jipukada was struck by a cannon shot and died.
translations.idiomatic: On the campaign against the Ming he attacked Fengji Fort. Ming zongbing Li Bingcheng marched to relieve it, and in the fighting the Ming troops fled into the city. Our army pursued them to the moat; great guns fired from the wall, and Jipukada was killed by a cannon shot.

sentences.zh: 天聰八年，贈二等參將。

translations.literal: In Tiancong 8 he was posthumously granted second-rank colonel.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 8 he was posthumously made second-rank colonel.

sentences.zh: 子瓜爾察，襲。

translations.literal: His son Guaercha inherited the post.
translations.idiomatic: His son Guaercha inherited the office.

sentences.zh: 吳巴海，瓜爾佳氏，自烏喇歸太祖。

translations.literal: Wu Bahai, of the Guwalgiya clan, came from Ula to submit to the Taizu.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Bahai was of the Guwalgiya clan and came from Ula to submit to Taizu.

sentences.zh: 太祖討尼堪外蘭，吳​​巴海實從。

translations.literal: When the Taizu attacked Nikhan Wailan, Wu Bahai was indeed among his followers.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizu attacked Nikhan Wailan, Wu Bahai was in fact among those who followed him.

sentences.zh: 隸滿洲鑲藍旗，授牛錄額真。

translations.literal: He was enrolled in the Manchu Bordered Blue Banner and appointed niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: He was placed in the Manchu Bordered Blue Banner and appointed niru captain.

sentences.zh: 天聰元年四月，從貝勒阿敏伐朝鮮，攻義州，與梅勒額真阿山、穆克譚等先登，克之。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of Tiancong 1 he followed Prince Amin against Korea, attacked Uiju, and with meiren-i ejen Ashan, Mukedan, and others was first over the wall and took it.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of Tiancong 1 he followed Prince Amin against Korea and attacked Uiju. With Meiren Commanders Ashan, Mukedan, and others he was first over the wall and captured the city.

sentences.zh: 五月，從太宗伐明，攻錦州，敵來犯，我師少卻，吳巴海為殿，督戰敗敵。

translations.literal: In the fifth month he followed Taizong against Ming and attacked Jinzhou; the enemy came to attack; our army gave ground slightly; Wu Bahai served as rearguard, urged the fight, and defeated the enemy.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he followed Taizong against the Ming and attacked Jinzhou. When the enemy counterattacked and our army fell back a little, Wu Bahai commanded the rearguard, pressed the fight, and drove them off.

sentences.zh: 五年，與梅勒額真蒙阿圖伐瓦爾喀，略額黑庫倫、額勒約索二部，收降人數千，上郊勞，賜宴，賜號「巴圖魯」。

translations.literal: In the fifth year with meiren-i ejen Meng'atu he campaigned against Warka, overran the Ehe Kulun and Ele Yuesuo tribes, received the surrender of several thousand people; the sovereign received him with suburban rites, granted a feast, and bestowed the title "Baturu".
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he campaigned with Meiren Commander Meng'atu against Warka, overran the Ehe Kulun and Ele Yuesuo tribes, and accepted the surrender of several thousand people. The sovereign welcomed him with suburban rites, gave a feast, and bestowed the title Baturu.

sentences.zh: 六年，從伐察哈爾，林丹汗西遁，上命吳巴海逐逋逃，斬察哈爾兵五，獲其馬及牲畜。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he joined the campaign against the Chakhar; Lin Dan Khan fled west; the sovereign ordered Wu Bahai to pursue fugitives; he killed five Chakhar soldiers and seized their horses and livestock.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he joined the campaign against the Chakhar. When Lin Dan Khan fled west the sovereign ordered Wu Bahai to pursue fugitives; he killed five Chakhar soldiers and captured their horses and livestock.

sentences.zh: 旋率師伐烏扎喇，部署所將兵四道並進，會敵方漁於握黑河，吳巴海揮騎直前，斬三百餘人，得其輜重。

translations.literal: Soon he led troops against the Uzhala, deployed his command in four columns advancing together, encountered the enemy fishing on the Wohei River, Wu Bahai waved his cavalry straight forward, killed more than three hundred men, and seized their baggage.
translations.idiomatic: He soon led a force against the Uzhala, divided his troops into four columns, and advanced together. Finding the enemy fishing on the Wohei River, Wu Bahai charged straight in with his cavalry, killed more than three hundred men, and took their baggage.

sentences.zh: 七年，與牛錄額真郎格如朝鮮互市，得瓦爾喀部長族屬十五人以歸。

translations.literal: In the seventh year with niru ejen Langge he went to Korea for border trade and brought back fifteen kinsmen of a Warka chieftain.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year he went to Korea for border trade with Niru Captain Langge and brought back fifteen kinsmen of a Warka chieftain.

sentences.zh: 八年，與吉思哈伐東海虎爾哈部。

translations.literal: In the eighth year with Jisiha he campaigned against the Eastern Sea Hurka tribes.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year he campaigned with Jisiha against the Eastern Sea Hurka tribes.

sentences.zh: 語詳吉思哈傳。

translations.literal: The account is given in full in the biography of Jisiha.
translations.idiomatic: The full account appears in the biography of Jisiha.

sentences.zh: 十二月，復與牛錄額真景固爾岱將四百人伐瓦爾喀，降屯長分得里，收阿庫里尼滿部眾千餘。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month he again joined niru ejen Jinggu'erdai in leading four hundred men against Warka, received the surrender of tun chief Fendeli, and brought in more than a thousand people of the Akuriniman tribe.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month he again joined Niru Captain Jinggu'erdai in leading four hundred men against Warka, accepted the surrender of tun chief Fendeli, and brought in more than a thousand people of the Akuriniman tribe.

sentences.zh: 師還，上命大臣迎勞，以所獲賚之。

translations.literal: On the army's return the sovereign ordered ministers to welcome and reward him, bestowing on him what had been captured.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned, the sovereign ordered ministers to welcome him with honors and rewarded him with the spoils.

sentences.zh: 九年，從貝勒岳託率師鎮歸化城。

translations.literal: In the ninth year he followed Prince Yueto in leading troops to garrison Guihua city.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year he followed Prince Yueto in leading a garrison force at Guihua city.

sentences.zh: 土默特人訐部長博碩克圖，謂其子陰遣使與明通，岳託遣吳巴海及甲喇額真阿爾津等四人要諸途，毛罕私以告，喀爾喀人潛遁，吳巴海追獲之，並得明使。

translations.literal: A Tümed man accused tribal chief Boshuotu of secretly sending envoys to communicate with the Ming; Yueto sent Wu Bahai and jalan ejen Arjin and three others to block the roads; Mao Han privately informed them; the Khalkha men fled in secret; Wu Bahai pursued and captured them, and also seized the Ming envoys.
translations.idiomatic: A Tümed man accused tribal chief Boshuotu of secretly sending envoys to the Ming. Yueto dispatched Wu Bahai, Jalan Commander Arjin, and three others to block the roads. Mao Han tipped them off in private; the Khalkha envoys slipped away, but Wu Bahai pursued and captured them along with the Ming envoys.

sentences.zh: 毛罕者，博碩克圖子乳母之夫也，初從土默特來降，既而有叛志，號博碩克圖子為汗，自號貝勒。

translations.literal: Mao Han was the husband of Boshuotu's son's wet nurse; at first he came over from the Tümed, but afterward he harbored rebellious intent, styled Boshuotu's son khan, and called himself beile.
translations.idiomatic: Mao Han was the husband of the wet nurse of Boshuotu's son. He had first defected from the Tümed, but later turned rebellious, proclaimed Boshuotu's son khan, and styled himself beile.

sentences.zh: 吳巴海既執喀爾喀使人，遂殺毛罕。

translations.literal: After Wu Bahai had seized the Khalkha envoys, he then killed Mao Han.
translations.idiomatic: Once Wu Bahai had seized the Khalkha envoys, he killed Mao Han.

sentences.zh: 十年，授梅勒額真，世職一等甲喇章京。

translations.literal: In the tenth year he was appointed meiren-i ejen with the hereditary rank of first-class jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year he was appointed meiren commander with the hereditary rank of first-class jalan colonel.

sentences.zh: 崇德元年六月，進三等梅勒章京，移鎮寧古塔。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of Chongde 1 he was advanced to third-rank meiren janggin and transferred to garrison Ningguta.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the first year of Chongde he was promoted to third-rank meiren colonel and transferred to garrison Ningguta.

sentences.zh: 十二月，喀木尼漢部葉雷等叛，將其孥俱亡，吳巴海部兵逐之。

translations.literal: In the twelfth month Yelei and others of the Kamnihan tribe rebelled, fled with all their families, and Wu Bahai detached troops to pursue them.
translations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month Yelei and others of the Kamnihan tribe rebelled and fled with their entire families; Wu Bahai sent troops in pursuit.

sentences.zh: 行數十日無所見，見宿雁三，射之，一雁負矢飛且墮，往取之，見遺火，知逃者自此過。

translations.literal: After marching for several tens of days they saw nothing; they saw three resting wild geese, shot them; one goose flew off with an arrow in it and then fell; going to retrieve it they saw a leftover fire and knew the fugitives had passed this way.
translations.idiomatic: They marched for many days without finding anyone. Then they saw three resting wild geese and shot at them; one flew off with an arrow in it, then fell. When they went to retrieve it they found embers and knew the fugitives had passed that way.

sentences.zh: 躡其跡，及之於溫多，獲其孥。

translations.literal: Following their tracks they overtook them at Wenduo and captured their families.
translations.idiomatic: They followed the trail, caught up with them at Wenduo, and seized their families.

sentences.zh: 葉雷入山，追及圍之，諭使降，不可，射之。

translations.literal: Yelei entered the mountains; they pursued, surrounded him, urged him to surrender; he would not, and they shot him.
translations.idiomatic: Yelei fled into the mountains. They pursued him, surrounded him, and urged him to surrender, but he refused, so they shot him.

sentences.zh: 葉雷將注矢，有狐起於前，觸葉雷弓，弓墜，遂射殺葉雷及其從者。

translations.literal: As Yelei was about to nock an arrow a fox sprang up before him, struck Yelei's bow, the bow fell, and they shot and killed Yelei and his followers.
translations.idiomatic: As Yelei was fitting an arrow to his bow, a fox sprang up in front of him, struck his bow so that it fell, and they shot and killed Yelei and his followers.

sentences.zh: 師還，太宗命諸固山額真迎勞。

translations.literal: On the army's return Taizong ordered all the gūsa i da to welcome and reward them.
translations.idiomatic: When the army returned, Taizong ordered all the banner commanders to welcome them with honors.

sentences.zh: 二年，敘功，進三等昂邦章京，賜衣服、僕、馬、莊田。
