translations.literal: In the second year, when merit was assessed, he was advanced to third-rank angbang janggin and granted clothing, servants, horses, and estate fields.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, for his services, he was promoted to third-rank angbang colonel and given clothing, servants, horses, and estate lands.

sentences.zh: 三年，與梅勒額真吳善帥師戍歸化城。

translations.literal: In the third year with meiren-i ejen Wushan he led troops to garrison Guihua city.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he joined Meiren Commander Wushan in garrisoning Guihua city.

sentences.zh: 旋坐匿罪人、徇廝養卒盜米，罷梅勒額真，論罰，四年卒，分世職為一等甲喇章京者一，為牛錄章京者二，授其子弟。

translations.literal: Soon he was convicted of concealing criminals and indulging camp servants who stole grain; he was dismissed as meiren-i ejen and sentenced to punishment; in the fourth year he died; the hereditary offices were divided into one first-class jalan janggin and two niru janggin, granted to his sons and younger brothers.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon found guilty of concealing criminals and covering for camp servants who stole grain. He was removed as meiren commander and punished. He died in the fourth year. His hereditary offices were split into one first-class jalan colonel and two niru colonels, which were granted to his sons and younger brothers.

sentences.zh: 康喀勒，納喇氏，輝發貝勒王機砮之孫也。

translations.literal: Kang Kalei, of the Nara clan, was a grandson of Huifa beile Wangjitu.
translations.idiomatic: Kang Kalei was of the Nara clan and a grandson of Huifa Prince Wangjitu.

sentences.zh: 太祖時，偕從兄通貴率族屬來歸，隸滿洲鑲紅旗，授牛錄額真。

translations.literal: In the Taizu era he came to submit together with his cousin Tonggui leading their clansmen, was enrolled in the Manchu Bordered Red Banner, and was appointed niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: During the Taizu era he came over with his cousin Tonggui at the head of their clansmen, was placed in the Manchu Bordered Red Banner, and appointed niru captain.

sentences.zh: 天聰六年，從伐察哈爾部。

translations.literal: In Tiancong 6 he joined the campaign against the Chakhar tribes.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 6 he joined the campaign against the Chakhar.

sentences.zh: 八年正月，上以察哈爾林丹汗西遁，其部眾流散錫爾哈、錫伯圖，命康喀勒與岱青塔布囊等率蒙古及諸部駐牧兵往取以歸。

translations.literal: In the first month of the eighth year, because Chakhar Lin Dan Khan had fled west and his tribesmen were scattered at Xierha and Xibetu, the sovereign ordered Kang Kalei with Daiqing tabunang and others to lead Mongol and garrison-pasture troops of various tribes to bring them back.
translations.idiomatic: In the first month of the eighth year, because Chakhar ruler Lin Dan Khan had fled west and his people were scattered at Xierha and Xibetu, the sovereign ordered Kang Kalei, Daiqing tabunang, and others to lead Mongol troops and garrison forces from various tribes to bring them in.

sentences.zh: 五月，授世職牛錄章京。

translations.literal: In the fifth month he was granted the hereditary rank of niru janggin.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he was granted the hereditary rank of niru colonel.

sentences.zh: 崇德三年，兼刑部副理事官。

translations.literal: In Chongde 3 he concurrently served as associate councilor of the Board of Punishments.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Chongde he also served as associate councilor of the Board of Punishments.

sentences.zh: 五年，擢鑲紅旗蒙古梅勒額真。

translations.literal: In the fifth year he was promoted to Mongol meiren-i ejen of the Bordered Red Banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth year he was made Mongol meiren commander of the Bordered Red Banner.

sentences.zh: 六年，從伐明，圍錦州，並攻松山城。

translations.literal: In the sixth year he joined the Ming campaign, besieged Jinzhou, and also attacked Songshan city.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year he joined the campaign against the Ming, besieged Jinzhou, and also assaulted Songshan city.

sentences.zh: 七年，松山、錦州皆下，复克塔山城。

translations.literal: In the seventh year Songshan and Jinzhou both fell, and he again took Tashan city.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year Songshan and Jinzhou both fell, and he also captured Tashan city.

sentences.zh: 尋追論攻松山避敵、克塔山與固山額真葉臣爭功，罪當死，太宗特貰之。

translations.literal: Soon he was retrospectively judged for avoiding the enemy at Songshan and disputing merit for taking Tashan with gūsa i da Yechen; the crime warranted death, but Taizong specially pardoned him.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon called to account for having shirked the enemy at Songshan and quarreling over credit for Tashan with Banner Commander Yechen. The offense carried the death penalty, but Taizong specially spared him.

sentences.zh: 順治初，從入關，擊李自成，加半個前程。

translations.literal: In early Shunzhi he joined the crossing into China, attacked Li Zicheng, and was granted half a regular stipend.
translations.idiomatic: Early in Shunzhi he crossed the pass with the army, fought Li Zicheng, and received half a regular stipend.

sentences.zh: 尋從豫親王多鐸下江南，與固山額真準塔自徐州水陸並進，次清河。

translations.literal: Soon he followed Prince Yu Dodo south of the Yangzi, and with gūsa i da Zhunta advanced together by land and water from Xuzhou, halting at Qinghe.
translations.idiomatic: He soon followed Prince Yu Dodo into the south, and with Banner Commander Zhunta advanced by land and water from Xuzhou, encamping at Qinghe.

sentences.zh: 明總兵劉澤清遣部將馬花豹、張思義等率戰艦千餘、兵數万，屯黃淮口。

translations.literal: Ming zongbing Liu Zeqing sent his subordinates Ma Huabao, Zhang Siyi, and others to lead more than a thousand warships and tens of thousands of troops to encamp at the mouth of the Huang and Huai rivers.
translations.idiomatic: Ming zongbing Liu Zeqing sent his generals Ma Huabao, Zhang Siyi, and others with more than a thousand warships and tens of thousands of troops to encamp at the mouth of the Huang and Huai rivers.

sentences.zh: 康喀勒與游擊范炳、吉天相等發砲毀其舟，分兵追擊，澤清走，淮安下。

translations.literal: Kang Kalei, together with guerrilla officers Fan Bing, Ji Tianxiang, and others, opened fire with cannon and destroyed their boats, divided troops to pursue, Ze Qing fled, and Huai'an fell.
translations.idiomatic: Kang Kalei, with guerrilla officers Fan Bing, Ji Tianxiang, and others, shelled and smashed their fleet, then split his force in pursuit. Zeqing fled and Huai'an was taken.

sentences.zh: 復與梅勒額真譚布擊明總漕田仰，仰方屯湖口橋，以三千人迎戰，擊破之；

translations.literal: He again joined Meiren-i ejen Tan Bu to attack Ming Grand Canal Supervisor Tian Yang. Yang had just encamped at Hukou Bridge and met battle with three thousand men; they broke him.
translations.idiomatic: He again joined meiren commander Tan Bu against Ming Grand Canal Supervisor Tian Yang. Yang was encamped at Hukou Bridge with three thousand men to give battle; they routed him.

sentences.zh: 又戰於三里橋，逐至海岸，獲舟八十；

translations.literal: They fought again at Sanli Bridge, pursued to the seacoast, and captured eighty boats.
translations.idiomatic: They fought again at Sanli Bridge, drove the enemy to the coast, and seized eighty boats.

sentences.zh: 又戰於如皋，攻通州，以雲梯克其城，旁近諸縣皆下。

translations.literal: They fought again at Rugao, attacked Tongzhou, took the city with cloud ladders, and the nearby counties all submitted.
translations.idiomatic: They fought again at Rugao, assaulted Tongzhou, stormed the walls with siege ladders, and the neighboring counties all fell.

sentences.zh: 二年十一月，授鎮守江寧梅勒額真。

translations.literal: In the eleventh month of the second year he was appointed meiren-i ejen to guard Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh month of the second year he was made meiren commander charged with defending Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 時江北未定，群相聚為亂，江寧有諜為內應者，康喀勒與駐防總管巴山先期捕治，殺三十人而定。

translations.literal: At the time the north of the Yangzi was not yet settled and groups gathered in rebellion. Jiangning had spies acting as internal collaborators; Kang Kalei and Garrison Commander Ba Shan seized and punished them beforehand, killing thirty men, and order was restored.
translations.idiomatic: The north bank was still unsettled and bands were rising everywhere. Spies inside Jiangning were ready to open the gates; Kang Kalei and garrison commander Ba Shan struck first, executed thirty men, and the city was secured.

sentences.zh: 已而明潞安王硃誼石集眾二萬餘，分三道來攻，康喀勒等擊卻之。

translations.literal: Before long Ming Prince of Lu'an Zhu Yishi gathered more than twenty thousand men and attacked in three columns; Kang Kalei and the others drove them back.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward the Ming Prince of Lu'an, Zhu Yishi, mustered more than twenty thousand men and advanced in three columns; Kang Kalei and his officers beat them off.

sentences.zh: 三年，以功進三等甲喇章京，世襲。

translations.literal: In the third year, for merit he was promoted to third-rank jalan janggin, hereditary.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, for his services, he was advanced to third-rank colonel with a hereditary grant.

sentences.zh: 四年，改三等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was changed to third-rank adaha hafan.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year his rank was converted to third-rank adaha hafan.

sentences.zh: 旋卒。

translations.literal: Soon he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died soon after.

sentences.zh: 子洛多，襲職。

translations.literal: His son Luoduo succeeded to the post.
translations.idiomatic: His son Luoduo inherited the office.

sentences.zh: 和托，康喀勒從兄之子也。

translations.literal: Hetuo was a son of Kang Kalei's cousin.
translations.idiomatic: Hetuo was Kang Kalei's cousin's son.

sentences.zh: 順治元年，以噶布什賢甲喇章京從入關，破李自成潼關，移兵下江寧。

translations.literal: In the first year of Shunzhi, as gabsihiyan jalan janggin he followed entry into the passes, broke Li Zicheng at Tong Pass, and shifted troops to take Jiangning.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 1, holding the rank of brave-guards colonel, he crossed the pass with the army, routed Li Zicheng at Tong Pass, and marched on to take Jiangning.

sentences.zh: 復從貝勒博洛徇浙江，破明總兵方國安等於杭州。

translations.literal: He again followed Beile Boluo into Zhejiang and defeated Ming zongbing Fang Guo'an and others at Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He again followed Prince Boluo into Zhejiang and defeated Ming zongbing Fang Guo'an and others at Hangzhou.

sentences.zh: 复略福建，所向克捷。

translations.literal: He again raided Fujian, meeting success wherever he went.
translations.idiomatic: He raided Fujian again and met success wherever he turned.

sentences.zh: 攻汀州，先登，克其城。

translations.literal: Attacking Tingzhou, he was first to scale the wall and took the city.
translations.idiomatic: At Tingzhou he was first over the wall and the city fell.

sentences.zh: 論功，並遇恩詔，授拜他喇布勒哈番兼拖沙喇哈番，世襲。

translations.literal: When merit was assessed, meeting also an amnesty edict, he was granted baitalabule hafan with the added tosara hafan, hereditary.
translations.idiomatic: When honors were reckoned, he also benefited from an amnesty edict and received baitalabule hafan with the added tosara hafan, both hereditary.

sentences.zh: 十一年，從征雲南，擊敗明將白文選，進取永昌，奪瀾滄江鐵索橋。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year he followed the Yunnan campaign, defeated Ming general Bai Wenxuan, advanced to take Yongchang, and seized the iron-chain bridge on the Lancang River.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year he joined the Yunnan expedition, defeated the Ming general Bai Wenxuan, took Yongchang, and captured the iron-chain bridge on the Lancang.

sentences.zh: 康熙九年，卒。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Kangxi he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in Kangxi 9.

sentences.zh: 瑪拉，和托弟也。

translations.literal: Mala was Hetuo's younger brother.
translations.idiomatic: Mala was Hetuo's younger brother.

sentences.zh: 順治十二年，以三等侍衛署甲喇額真。

translations.literal: In the twelfth year of Shunzhi he served as acting jalan ejen with the rank of third-class bodyguard.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 12 he held the rank of third-class bodyguard and acted as jalan commander.

sentences.zh: 從固山額真伊勒德攻舟山，從擺牙喇纛章京穆成額破鄭成功兵於泉州；

translations.literal: He followed gūsa i da Yilede to attack Zhoushan and followed baiyalara dafu janggin Mucheng'e to defeat Zheng Chenggong's troops at Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: He followed Banner Commander Yilede against Zhoushan and followed standard-bearer colonel Mucheng'e in defeating Zheng Chenggong's forces at Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 十六年，從安南將軍達素擊成功廈門：皆有功。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year he followed Annan jiangjun Dasu to strike Chenggong at Xiamen—all with merit.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year he followed Annan General Dasu against Chenggong at Xiamen, earning merit in both actions.

sentences.zh: 康熙二十二年，卒。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year of Kangxi he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in Kangxi 22.

sentences.zh: 通嘉，康喀勒兄孫。

translations.literal: Tongjia was Kang Kalei's elder brother's grandson.
translations.idiomatic: Tongjia was the grandson of Kang Kalei's elder brother.

sentences.zh: 初襲其父莽佳三等阿達哈哈番。

translations.literal: At first he succeeded his father Mangjia as third-rank adaha hafan.
translations.idiomatic: He first inherited his father Mangjia's third-rank adaha hafan.

sentences.zh: 順治十八年，以護軍參領從靖東將軍濟什喀討山東賊於七。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year of Shunzhi, as a company leader of the guard corps, he followed Pacifying-East General Jishika to subdue Shandong bandits under Yu Qi.
translations.idiomatic: In Shunzhi 18, as a guard company leader, he followed Pacifying-East General Jishika against the Shandong rebel Yu Qi.

sentences.zh: 於七據棲霞、岠褭山為亂，其黨呂思曲、俞三等以數千人拒戰，通嘉擊敗之，賊遂以平。

translations.literal: Yu Qi held Qixia and Juniao mountains in revolt; his partisans Lü Siqu, Yu San, and others resisted with several thousand men. Tongjia defeated them and the bandits were pacified.
translations.idiomatic: Yu Qi had seized the Qixia and Juniao ranges; his lieutenants Lü Siqu, Yu San, and others met him with several thousand men. Tongjia routed them and the rebellion was put down.

sentences.zh: 康熙六年，改前鋒參領。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Kangxi he was transferred to vanguard company leader.
translations.idiomatic: In Kangxi 6 he was made a vanguard company leader.

sentences.zh: 十四年，從信郡王鄂托討察哈爾布爾尼，師至達祿，布爾尼為伏山谷間，通嘉督所部盡擊殺之，布爾尼以三十騎遁。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year he followed Prince Xin Ertuo against Chakhar Burni. When the army reached Dalu, Burni lay in ambush in the valley; Tongjia supervised his men in slaughtering them all, and Burni fled with thirty horsemen.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year he followed Prince Xin Ertuo against the Chakhar leader Burni. At Dalu, Burni hid troops in the valleys; Tongjia led his men in cutting them down to the last man, and Burni escaped with only thirty riders.

sentences.zh: 以功加拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: For merit he was given the added title tosara hafan.
translations.idiomatic: For his service he received the added rank of tosara hafan.

sentences.zh: 旋坐事削。

translations.literal: Soon he was stripped for an offense.
translations.idiomatic: He was soon stripped of rank for an offense.

sentences.zh: 十八年，以護軍統領從討吳三桂，破譚弘於雲陽。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year, as commander of the guard corps, he joined the campaign against Wu Sangui and defeated Tan Hong at Yunyang.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year, commanding the guard corps, he joined the campaign against Wu Sangui and defeated Tan Hong at Yunyang.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，遷本旗蒙古都統。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year he was transferred to Mongol commander of his banner.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-third year he was appointed Mongol lieutenant-general of his banner.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，卒。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year he died.
translations.idiomatic: He died in the twenty-fourth year.

sentences.zh: 薩璧翰，亦納喇氏。

translations.literal: Sabihan was also of the Nara clan.
translations.idiomatic: Sabihan was also of the Nara clan.

sentences.zh: 父三檀，自輝發率屬歸太祖，授牛錄額真，隸滿洲正藍旗。

translations.literal: His father Santan, from Huifa, led his followers to submit to Taizu and was appointed niru ejen, enrolled in the Manchu Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: His father Santan came over from Huifa at the head of his clansmen, was made niru captain, and was registered in the Manchu Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 卒，薩璧翰與其兄薩珠瑚並授牛錄額真。

translations.literal: When he died, Sabihan and his elder brother Sazhuhu were both appointed niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: After his death Sabihan and his elder brother Sazhuhu were both appointed niru captains.

sentences.zh: 太宗即位，以薩璧翰列十六大臣，佐正藍旗。

translations.literal: When Taizong took the throne, Sabihan was numbered among the sixteen great ministers to assist the Plain Blue Banner.
translations.idiomatic: When Taizong succeeded, Sabihan was named one of the sixteen great ministers to assist the Plain Blue Banner.

sentences.zh: 天聰五年，擢戶部承政。

translations.literal: In Tiancong 5 he was promoted to Minister of the Board of Revenue.
translations.idiomatic: In Tiancong 5 he was promoted to minister of the Board of Revenue.

sentences.zh: 八月，上自將伐明，圍大凌河，城兵出禦，薩璧翰與戰，舍馬而步，逐敵薄壕。

translations.literal: In the eighth month the sovereign personally led a campaign against Ming and besieged Dalinhe. When the garrison came out to defend, Sabihan joined the fight, left his horse to fight on foot, and pursued the enemy close to the moat.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month the sovereign led the Ming campaign in person and besieged Dalinhe. When the garrison sallied forth, Sabihan fought on foot after leaving his horse and pressed the enemy to the edge of the ditch.

sentences.zh: 城上發砲矢，甲士巴遜沒於陣，薩璧翰力戰，入敵陣，取其屍還。

translations.literal: The wall men loosed cannon and arrows; armored soldier Bason fell in battle. Sabihan fought hard, entered the enemy ranks, and brought back his corpse.
translations.idiomatic: From the walls cannon and arrows rained down; armored soldier Bason was killed in the fight. Sabihan battled on, broke into the enemy line, and carried his body back.

sentences.zh: 八年五月，上自將伐察哈爾，貝勒濟爾哈朗居守，薩璧翰與梅勒額真蒙阿圖副之。

translations.literal: In the fifth month of the eighth year the sovereign personally led a campaign against Chakhar. Beile Jirhalang remained to guard the capital; Sabihan and Meiren-i ejen Monggatu assisted him.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifth month of the eighth year the sovereign marched against the Chakhar in person. Prince Jirhalang stayed behind as regent, with Sabihan and meiren commander Monggatu as his deputies.

sentences.zh: 考滿，授世職甲喇章京。

translations.literal: At the merit review he was granted hereditary jalan janggin.
translations.idiomatic: At the triennial review he received the hereditary rank of jalan colonel.

sentences.zh: 崇德二年，從伐朝鮮，取皮島。

translations.literal: In Chongde 2 he followed the Korean campaign and took Pidao.
translations.idiomatic: In Chongde 2 he joined the Korean campaign and captured Pidao.

sentences.zh: 師還，薩璧翰與其兄薩珠瑚發貝子碩託以廝役冒甲士請卹，坐論罰，薩璧翰初隸碩託，至是命改隸饒餘貝勒阿巴泰。

translations.literal: When the army returned, Sabihan and his brother Sazhuhu reported Prince Suoto for using servants to impersonate armored soldiers in seeking condolence payments; on conviction they were fined. Sabihan had first been under Suoto and was now ordered transferred to Surplus Prince Abatai.
translations.idiomatic: On the army's return Sabihan and Sazhuhu denounced Prince Suoto for passing off servants as armored men to claim death benefits; the case brought fines. Sabihan had served under Suoto; he was now reassigned to Surplus Prince Abatai.

sentences.zh: 旋以薩璧翰從子侍衛吳達禮從伐朝鮮，私役甲士，坐奪世職。

translations.literal: Soon Sabihan's nephew, guard Wudali, on the Korean campaign privately employed armored soldiers; on conviction Sabihan's hereditary rank was seized.
translations.idiomatic: Soon afterward Sabihan's nephew, guard Wudali, on the Korean campaign used armored soldiers for private service; Sabihan was stripped of his hereditary rank on conviction.

sentences.zh: 三年，改吏部右參政。

translations.literal: In the third year he was made Right Vice Councilor of the Board of Civil Appointments.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year he was made right vice councilor of the Board of Civil Appointments.

sentences.zh: 四年，授議政大臣。

translations.literal: In the fourth year he was appointed deliberative minister.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year he was appointed a deliberative minister.

sentences.zh: 六年八月，從伐明，攻錦州，明援兵自松山至，誘戰，薩璧翰被創，卒於軍。

translations.literal: In the sixth year, eighth month, he followed the Ming campaign to attack Jinzhou. Ming relief from Songshan arrived and offered battle; Sabihan was wounded and died in the army.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth month of the sixth year he joined the Ming campaign against Jinzhou. Ming relief from Songshan came up and offered battle; Sabihan was wounded and died in camp.

sentences.zh: 子漢楚哈、哈爾沁，皆授牛錄額真。

translations.literal: His sons Hanchuha and Ha'erqin were both appointed niru ejen.
translations.idiomatic: His sons Hanchuha and Ha'erqin were both appointed niru captains.

sentences.zh: 哈爾沁從討吳三桂，從討噶爾丹，皆有功，授拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: Ha'erqin joined campaigns against Wu Sangui and against Galdan, both with merit, and was granted tosara hafan.
translations.idiomatic: Ha'erqin campaigned against Wu Sangui and against Galdan, earning merit in both, and was granted tosara hafan.

sentences.zh: 漢楚哈子哈爾弼，授一等護衛，從擊鄭成功，戰廈門，歿於陣，亦授拖沙喇哈番。

translations.literal: Hanchuha's son Ha'erbi was appointed first-class guard. Following the strike on Zheng Chenggong, he fought at Xiamen and died in battle; he too was granted tosara hafan.
translations.idiomatic: Hanchuha's son Ha'erbi was made a first-class guard. In action against Zheng Chenggong he fought at Xiamen and fell in battle; he too received tosara hafan.

sentences.zh: 論曰：太祖初起，扈倫四部與為敵，四部之豪俊，先後來歸。

translations.literal: Commentary: When Taizu first rose, the four Hūlun tribes were his enemies; their outstanding men came over one after another.
translations.idiomatic: Commentary: When Taizu first rose, the four Hūlun tribes stood against him; their ablest men came over to him in time.

sentences.zh: 武理堪等自哈達，武納格、阿什達爾漢、鄂莫克圖等自葉赫，吉思哈等自烏喇，康喀勒等自輝發，皆能效奔走，立名氏。

translations.literal: Wu Likan and others from Hada, Wu Nage, Ashi Daerhan, E Moketu, and others from Yehe, Jisiha and others from Ula, Kang Kalei and others from Huifa—all could serve zealously and make their names.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Likan from Hada; Wu Nage, Ashi Daerhan, and E Moketu from Yehe; Jisiha from Ula; Kang Kalei from Huifa—they all served with zeal and won renown.

sentences.zh: 武納格其先出自蒙古，遂為「白奇超哈」統帥，勳績尤著。

translations.literal: Wu Nage's forebears came from Mongolia; he thus became commander of the "Baiqi chao ha," and his exploits were especially notable.
translations.idiomatic: Wu Nage's line sprang from the Mongols; he became commander of the "Baiqi chao ha," and his feats stood out above the rest.

sentences.zh: 四部有才而不能用，太祖股肱爪牙取於敵有餘。

translations.literal: The four tribes had talent but could not use it; Taizu drew arms and claws from the enemy with more than enough to spare.
translations.idiomatic: The four tribes had talent they could not keep; Taizu found more than enough right hands among his foes.

sentences.zh: 國之興亡，雖曰天命，豈非人事哉？

translations.literal: Whether a state rises or falls may be called Heaven's mandate—but is it not also the work of men?
translations.idiomatic: The rise and fall of states may be called Heaven's mandate—yet is it not also the work of men?
